label: data life cycle
definition: All stages in the process of data usage from idea conception to its discontinuation.

label: data holder
definition: Party that has legal control to authorize data processing of the data by other parties.

label: data user
definition: Party that is authorized to perform processing of data under the legal control of a data holder.

label: data quality
definition: Degree to which a collection of characteristics of data fulfills requirements.

label: data quality characteristic
definition: Category of data quality attributes that bears on data quality.

label: data quality model
definition: Defined set of characteristics with their sub-characteristics that provide a framework for specifying data quality requirements and evaluating data quality.

label: data quality measure
definition: Variable to which a value is assigned as the result of measurement of a data quality characteristic.

label: quality requirement
definition: Requirement for quality properties or attributes of a product, data or service.

label: measurement
definition: Set of operations having the object of determining a value of a measure.

label: measurement scale
definition: Ordered set of quantity values used in ranking quantities of a given kind according to magnitude.

label: analytics
definition: Composite concept consisting of data acquisition, collection, validation, processing including quantification, visualisation, documentation and interpretation.

label: attribute
definition: Property or characteristic of an object that can be distinguished quantitatively or qualitatively.

label: feature
definition: <machine learning> Measurable property of an object or event in the context of an analytics or ML task.

label: data quality management
definition: Coordinated activities to direct and control an organisation with regard to data quality.

label: data governance
definition: Property or ability for coordinated management of data asset management strategy, including policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines.

label: data provenance
definition: Information on the place and time of origin, derivation or generation of a dataset.

label: visualisation
definition: Representation of data in a visual form that enables a human to directly understand or interact with the data.

label: machine learning project
definition: Project that utilizes analytics and machine learning and is responsible for the associated data throughout the data's entire life cycle.

label: data architecture
definition: Design that describes the structure and arrangement of data and the processes for managing data at the organisation level.

label: data item
definition: Smallest identifiable unit of data within a certain context.

label: data record
definition: Set of related data items treated as a unit.

label: metadata
definition: Data that define and describe other data.

label: bounding box
definition: Minimum n-dimensional rectangle aligned with the axes of a coordinate system that entirely contains an object.

label: data
definition: Re-interpretable representation of information in a formalized manner suitable for communication, interpretation, or processing.

label: dataset
definition: Collection of data with a shared format.

label: data type
definition: Categorisation of an abstract set of possible values, characteristics, and set of operations for an attribute.

label: data value
definition: Content of a data item.

label: data frame
definition: Set of data records with a specific domain or purpose and the same data items, used for analytics and ML.

label: cluster
definition: Group of data having similar properties or characteristics as determined by a clustering algorithm.

label: empty data item
definition: Data item whose data value has no value, i.e. Null or None.

label: measured value
definition: Value attributed to a data quality measure obtained by measurement.

label: measurement function
definition: Algorithm or calculation performed to combine two or more quality measure elements.

label: overfitting
definition: <machine learning> Creating a model which fits the training data too precisely and fails to generalise on new data.

label: raw data
definition: Data in its originally acquired form from its source, before subsequent processing.

label: target data
definition: Data used in an analytics or ML task whose quality is measured.

label: organization
definition: Person or group of people that has its own functions with responsibilities, authorities and relationships to achieve its objectives.

label: data quality management system
definition: Part of an organisation's management system which addresses data quality planning, control, assurance and improvement.

label: data quality management life cycle
definition: Life cycle model providing guidance towards meeting quality requirements of data for analytics and ML with discrete stages for managing data quality.

label: data specification
definition: Document specifying data requirements, validated to be consistent and complete for the intended use.

label: data quality plan
definition: Document covering processes, activities and resources required to meet the data specification throughout the data life cycle.

label: data acquisition
definition: Process by which data are obtained, including collection, purchase, licensing, reuse or generation.

label: data preprocessing
definition: Processes applied to acquired data to improve its quality towards meeting the data specification.

label: data augmentation
definition: Processes that increase the diversity or quantity of data in a dataset in a controlled manner to meet the data specification.

label: data provisioning
definition: Process by which auditable data and metadata are delivered to users, meeting all specified requirements.

label: data decommissioning
definition: Process of retiring data either through transfer to a qualified recipient or deletion.

label: data life cycle quality gate
definition: Objectively assessable quality target for work products at each stage of the DQMLC; a stage shall only be entered with verified and validated input.

label: configuration management
definition: Planned and maintained activity defining requirements for uniquely identified and reproducible items produced or used during the data life cycle.

label: change management
definition: Planned and initiated process before any change to data, requirements or processes to ensure all impacts are assessed and approved.

label: risk management (data quality)
definition: Coordinated activities to ensure all risks to data quality are accounted for, assessed and if necessary mitigated.

label: stakeholder
definition: Person or organisation that can affect, be affected by, or perceive itself to be affected by a decision or activity related to data quality.

label: verification and validation
definition: Processes that monitor and assess data quality throughout all stages of the DQMLC using measurable quality criteria.

label: data quality improvement
definition: Application of data transformations to a dataset to improve its quality to the extent it meets the organisation's needs.

label: data quality assessment
definition: Use of data quality measures to evaluate whether a dataset meets the organisation's needs.

label: data quality report
definition: Document expressing data quality requirements, measures, results of measurements, and an assessment of whether data meets requirements.

label: data labelling
definition: Process of assigning values for target variables to training, validation and testing data for supervised ML.

label: data transformation
definition: Converting data from one representation or space to another with minimal loss of content.

label: data privacy
definition: Protection of personally identifiable information (PII) in datasets during data quality processes.

label: data interoperability
definition: Ability of data from one system to be understood and used by another system without special effort.

label: ground truth
definition: Data label or annotation that is assumed to be correct or accurate for use as training or testing data.

label: data sampling
definition: Process of selecting a subset of data from a dataset according to a defined method.

label: data annotation
definition: Process of adding metadata or labels to raw data to make it meaningful for ML training.

label: training data
definition: Data used to train an ML algorithm to produce a trained ML model.

label: validation data
definition: Data used to provide an evaluation of the trained ML model and for tuning its non-learnable parameters to prevent underfitting or overfitting.

label: test data
definition: Data used to evaluate the final performance of a trained ML model independently of training.

label: production data
definition: Data provided to a deployed ML model in the operational environment.

label: representativeness
definition: Degree to which the statistical properties of a dataset reflect those of the target population for the intended use.

label: data bias
definition: Systematic deviation in data from a true value or representation of the target population, potentially leading to unfair or inaccurate outcomes.

label: data drift
definition: Change over time in the statistical properties of data used in analytics or ML that can degrade model performance.

label: data completeness
definition: Degree to which all required data items are present in a dataset and have defined, non-empty values.

label: data accuracy
definition: Degree to which data correctly represents the real-world values it is intended to model.

label: data consistency
definition: Degree to which data is free from contradictions and coherent within a dataset and across related datasets.

label: data currentness
definition: Degree to which data represents the current state of the phenomenon it models at a given point in time.

label: data relevance
definition: Degree to which data is applicable and useful for the specified analytics or ML purpose.

label: data balance
definition: Degree to which the distribution of values across categories in a dataset reflects the intended distribution for the ML task.
